# Pixel Memory Match

A simple offline memory-match game built with HTML, CSS, and plain JavaScript.

## How to Play

- Click or tap any card to flip it.
- Flip two cards at a time to find matching colored pairs.
- Matched pairs stay open.
- The move counter increases with each pair attempt.
- Match all 8 pairs to win!
- Use the **New Game** button to reshuffle and start over.

## How to Run

Open `index.html` in any modern web browser. No server or internet connection required.

## Files

- `index.html` — Game structure and content.
- `styles.css` — Themed styling and responsive layout.
- `script.js` — Game logic (deck, shuffle, flip, match, win detection).

## Accessibility

- All interactive elements are keyboard-accessible.
- Cards and the New Game button have visible focus states.
- The move counter and win message use live regions for screen readers.
